findings.title: Findings converge on the capture state copied into the listener-thread log handlers
findings.why_it_matters: The capture decision is made at dequeue by two handlers each holding a pushed copy of the set.
findings.chosen: A: Re-evaluate the mechanism
findings.choice_reason: User asked whether the exception should exist at all since no peer has it; re-evaluation removed log_persistence_level (D2) instead of building the exception.

findings.title: Taking the lifecycle lock makes the toggle unavailable while an app is starting or reloading
findings.why_it_matters: The toggle 409s for the whole of a hung startup, when DEBUG is wanted most.
findings.recommended: A: No lock; skip the 409 pre-check
findings.chosen: A: No lock; skip the 409 pre-check

findings.title: Constructing an App would depend on hassette.app_handler, which AppTestHarness never wires
findings.why_it_matters: Every AppTestHarness test would fail at construction.
findings.chosen: A: Factory passes it in

findings.title: The capture rule needs a second copy in LogCaptureHandler
findings.why_it_matters: Hints would not fire for captured lines, or would fire when persistence is disabled.
findings.chosen: Superseded by Finding 1

findings.title: The toggle's steps have no specified order, so in-flight records are lost at the edges
findings.why_it_matters: Dequeue-time decisions lose records at toggle edges.
findings.recommended: A: Specify order and accept off-edge loss
findings.chosen: Superseded by Finding 1

findings.title: A captured pair outlives its instance's config block and re-arms capture silently
findings.why_it_matters: Capture can start without the required WARNING and off can't reach the pair.
findings.chosen: A: Prune with prune_stale_failed

findings.title: The ON/OFF log lines' order relative to the level change can drop the OFF line
findings.why_it_matters: The OFF line is lost when framework logging is quieted to WARNING.
findings.chosen: ON line after levels are re-applied; OFF line before they are restored.

findings.title: Capture volume shares bounded, level-blind queues with every other log record
findings.why_it_matters: A DEBUG burst can crowd out WARNING/ERROR records.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: Attributed third-party DEBUG lines persist to the database, with no docs note
findings.why_it_matters: Client DEBUG output with URLs persists without users knowing.
findings.recommended: A: Add a docs note to log-levels.md
findings.chosen: A: Add a docs note to log-levels.md

findings.title: Re-apply recursion races with child creation during init
The status read reports intent, not what was applied
The toggle decides whether to update a live App from the registry's copy, not the App's
findings.why_it_matters: The toggle infers the App mirror's state from the registry, so a drifted mirror can't be repaired and status says on while loggers stay at config levels.
findings.chosen: In AppHandler.set_debug_capture, re-apply every targeted live instance and keep changed only to gate the WARNING; add a drifted-mirror test.

findings.title: Every DEBUG line now schedules a main-loop task and a JSON round-trip, even with no UI open
findings.why_it_matters: With the persistence floor gone, each DEBUG line costs a log_hint task, lock and JSON round-trip on the automation loop.
findings.recommended: A: Coalesce hints in LogCaptureHandler with a "hint already pending" flag cleared by the scheduled broadcast.
findings.chosen: A: Coalesce hints in LogCaptureHandler with a "hint already pending" flag cleared by the scheduled broadcast.

findings.title: A DEBUG burst can drop other apps' WARNING and ERROR lines, including the toggle's own "off" WARNING, with no pushed signal
findings.why_it_matters: The bounded log queue drops newest records of any level during a capture burst, visible only via health drop counters.
findings.recommended: A: Keep D2's accepted limitation as ratified.
findings.chosen: A: Keep D2's accepted limitation as ratified.
findings.choice_reason: Auto-picked as clear-cut: D2 ratified this exact consequence.

findings.title: Toggling capture broadcasts nothing, so push-fed copies of AppInstance.debug_capture go stale
findings.why_it_matters: A client caching app state from WS events would show a forgotten capture as off.
findings.recommended: A: Document debug_capture as read-on-request in its wire docstring.
findings.chosen: A: Document debug_capture as read-on-request in its wire docstring.
findings.choice_reason: Auto-picked as clear-cut: no push-fed consumer exists.

findings.title: Upgraders with a DEBUG override get it persisted with no startup signal unless they set the removed key
findings.why_it_matters: Configs that never set log_persistence_level silently start storing DEBUG lines from configured overrides.
findings.recommended: A: Keep the upgrade-guide note as the only signal.
findings.chosen: A: Keep the upgrade-guide note as the only signal.
findings.choice_reason: Auto-picked as clear-cut: D2 ratified it; B is migration-only code.

findings.title: App-wide off reports a different instance set than app-wide on
findings.why_it_matters: DebugCaptureResponse.instances after off can include stale names the status read hides.
findings.recommended: A: Keep the documented response shape.
findings.chosen: A: Keep the documented response shape.
findings.choice_reason: Auto-picked as clear-cut: the extra names are the only place a stale capture shows.

findings.title: Stopping a running orphan leaves its capture pair behind, unseen, contrary to D8's "stop ends both"
findings.why_it_matters: After stopping an orphan its pair names an instance neither configured nor running, invisible to status and unreachable by --instance off.
findings.recommended: A: Prune the stopped orphan's pair in the stop paths.
findings.chosen: A: Prune the stopped orphan's pair in the stop paths.

findings.title: New public framework names on App and Resource can collide with a user subclass
findings.why_it_matters: A user app defining debug_capture or the new method names overrides framework state silently.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: a user subclass that defines debug_capture or the new method names overrides framework state silently.
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation: a user subclass that defines debug_capture or the new method names overrides framework state silently.

findings.title: The capture WARNINGs say "every line is stored" even when persistence is down
findings.why_it_matters: With persistence down the WARNING claims storage that isn't happening.
findings.recommended: A: Make the capture WARNINGs reflect whether persistence is active.
findings.chosen: A: Make the capture WARNINGs reflect whether persistence is active.
findings.choice_reason: Done by dropping the storage clause.

findings.title: The removed-app capture clear runs after an awaited stop and is skipped if that stop escapes
findings.why_it_matters: A cancelled orphan stop leaves the removed app's capture on with no route to end it until restart.
findings.recommended: A: Put the capture clear in a finally after the orphan stop.
findings.chosen: A: Put the capture clear in a finally after the orphan stop.

findings.title: D6, D7 and D8 are pinned only by mocks and unit pieces, not through the real build path
findings.why_it_matters: The headline toggle-during-hung-startup scenario rests on reading code, not a test.
findings.recommended: A: Add an end-to-end test of toggling a mid-startup App and reloading it.
findings.chosen: A: Add an end-to-end test of toggling a mid-startup App and reloading it.
